sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: brucespringsteen.it record previews: a line the site writes between a record's facts and its Notes ("The original version is numbered." on All Those Years' LP) is no longer dropped, and "*PROMO*" leaves the title to become "promo" beside the kind (Official release or Bootleg).

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: brucespringsteen.it song and show previews: on a record page, its song and show links (until now dead "#" links) show a card on hover and open in the window on Space, as they do in the rendered table and on the other sites. A song shows its lyric versions, each with its note; a show its date, venue, setlist, notes and the records it is on, and a record there opens in the same window, with Back. On the record page a plain click still opens the site's own small window.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: brucespringsteen.it record pages (DB/detrec.aspx): a new "Tracklist" button shows the record the way MusicBrainz shows a release: a sub-table per record or disc (vinyl sides paired into records when the count adds up), Date, Show and Country split out of the source show, Notes, Ver and a Play tile; above it the record's notes, its facts as the page names them, the shows its tracks come from, and its photo. No request: everything comes from the page itself. It also works in the site's frameset, in the right-hand frame where the site shows the record you click in its list. Mockup: https://claude.ai/artifact/XULiW1dUFME9F4nbsrQokD
